newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays tightly mixed, trade light.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays tightly mixed, trade light.

text.p: White sugar futures maintained a broadly similar trading pattern to the morning activity although profit-takers capped March's gains at around $305.00 and caused the nearby white premium to narrow, traders said on Wednesday. The March/March arbitrage traded in to under $67 as New York's spot contract stayed firm but off the highs, they said.
At 1715 GMT nearby values were tightly mixed, with March down 10 cents at $304.70 and May up by the same amount at $304.50.
March dominated the total volume, which was on the light side at 1,009 lots.

Significant physical news was thin on the ground, although Russia's foreign trade ministry rejected market talk of bilateral negotiations with Cuba to buy 500,000 tonnes of sugar for second-quarter delivery.
Oman has allocated land in the Mina Qaboos port for a sugar refinery with annual capacity of 360,000 tonnes. The plant is expected to come on stream in late 1998.

Paris futures followed roughly the same course as London, where values were also tightly mixed. March was down 50 cents at $304.50 and May up 30 cents at the same level. Matif volume amounted to 938 lots.
